verdict.rationale: Plaid Identity Verification has configurable verification workflows built in the Workflow Management editor, so versioning and rollback is a fair question for this product. However, no evidence shows that templates can be versioned, that changes can be reviewed or diffed, or that prior versions can be restored. The ability to create and edit flows is an adjacent capability and does not count as version control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
